description: 100-question real-model golden set. Data cases use read-only oracle SQL; clarification, no-query and safety cases use control-flow assertions.

cases.question: 2026年商业目标最高的5个经营单元
cases.oracleSql: SELECT business_unit_name, commercial_target_amount FROM mart.v_target_achievement WHERE year=2026 ORDER BY commercial_target_amount DESC, business_unit_name LIMIT 5

cases.question: 2026年商解目标最高的5个经营单元
cases.oracleSql: SELECT business_unit_name, solution_target_amount FROM mart.v_target_achievement WHERE year=2026 ORDER BY solution_target_amount DESC, business_unit_name LIMIT 5

cases.question: 2026年完成率低于70%的经营单元，按完成率升序

cases.question: 2026年完成率超过90%的经营单元，按完成率降序

cases.oracleSql: SELECT business_unit_name, commercial_target_amount, revenue_amount, achievement_rate FROM mart.v_target_achievement WHERE year=2026 ORDER BY achievement_rate, business_unit_name

cases.question: 2025年商业目标最高的5个经营单元

cases.question: 2026年华东地区平均完成率是多少

cases.question: 2026年有多少经营单元的收入没有达到商业目标
